title: Register a typical passenger
why: Confirms the baseline registration works and persists a passenger with passport details.

steps.does: POST …/identity/register-user with FirstName Anna, LastName Meyer, Email anna.meyer@example.com, UserName anna.meyer, PassPortNumber DE9876543, Password Str0ng!Pass1, ConfirmPassword Str0ng!Pass1.

expect: Registration succeeds (success status). One User row exists with FirstName Anna, LastName Meyer, Email anna.meyer@example.com, PassPortNumber DE9876543, and a hashed password (not the plaintext).
